text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The day of Matikanefukukitaru's debut
has finally
arrived!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
My heart's racing! Wh-wh-what is this
massive
pressure I'm feeling?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
I haven't been this nervous since I went
to draw
my first fortune slip. I left
empty-handed because
I had no money,
but still...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: I just can't relax, Trainer! I'm so anxious.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Y-you're right! I have powerful allies in
my corner!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
I appreciate those inspiring words!
Thanks to you,
my heart's stopped
completely. Well, it's still
pumping, but
you know what I mean!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
All right, let me pray before the race
starts...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Glory be to the spinach leaf! Glory be to
the
spinach leaf! Your power shall be
put to the test!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
You got that, gods? It's not my skills
that are
being tested here, but yours! I
beg of thee, help
me get to the finish
line!
